basic_details.job_title: Lucknow University Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Lucknow University has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the Junior Research Assistant post, which is co-terminus with the project under advertisement number CST/ENV./D-1304. Applicants must hold an M.Sc. in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or Biochemistry, along with a 1st class in both graduation and postgraduate examinations, and be residents of Uttar Pradesh. The pay is Rs. 25,000 per month for the first year and Rs. 28,000 for the next year. Candidates can apply by email by sending an updated CV and all relevant documents to the Principal Investigator within 14 days from the date of advertise

how_to_apply: Prepare an updated CV along with all relevant documents supporting your educational qualifications and eligibility.
Send your updated CV and documents via email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Nidhi Dwivedi, at the email address: [email protected].
Ensure the application is submitted within 14 days from the date of advertisement (by 24 October 2026).

content_sections.heading: Lucknow University Junior Research Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: Impact of Microplastics on Aging and Transgenerational Health in Drosophila melanogaster
Rs. 25,000/- per month for the first year and Rs. 28,000/- for the next year
Upper age limit is 28 years as on 1st April, 2025

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational and residential requirements specified by the department to be eligible for the Junior Research Assistant position. Nationality/Residency: Indian nationals who are residents of Uttar Pradesh. Essential Qualification: M.Sc. in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or Biochemistry with 1st class in graduation and postgraduate examinations. Desirable Qualification: Practical skills in Drosophila culture maintenance and experimentation will be preferred. Age Limit: Upper age limit is 28 years as on 1st April, 2025.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is temporary and co-terminus with the project. The approved stipend is Rs. 25,000/- per month for the first year, which increases to Rs. 28,000/- for the next year.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and according to the project's requirements. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, which will be notified through email or phone on a short notice. Candidates must bring all original documents for verification at the time of the interview, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending.
